name: Salka-Singi
description: Salka to Singi. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF says the route to Kebnekaise/Nikkaluokta leaves official Kungsleden at Singi, while OSM includes the Singi-Kebnekaise connector in broader Kungsleden summer context.
Naturkartan API main line starts about 207 m from STF Salka hut, while OSM and secondary GPX start about 21-22 m from the hut and are continuous with the prior OSM section.
STF stage evidence says Singi-Kebnekaise is 15 km, while Singi cabin context says about 14 km west of Kebnekaise; OSM/Waymarked relation 17085819 computes about 14.31 km.
AllTrails says usually very busy, Trailforks says lighter traffic, and blogs report both event-heavy and quiet periods.
STF's snow/current-conditions page found for this section is from 2025-07-08, while Lansstyrelsen has a 2026-04-22 shoulder-season winter-route warning.

Skyddad natur Nationalparksplan layer returned a Kebnekaise proposed national park at Salka/midpoint, but no current national park/reserve/Natura 2000 overlap was confirmed from sampled current layers.
Model Singi-Kebnekaise/Nikkaluokta as connector/access metadata, not official mainline, unless a later product decision intentionally includes access branches.

facilities.name: Kuoperjakka dry toilet
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM toilet node/way; Naturkartan shelter record confirms dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet associated with the Kuoperjakka/Kebnekatan rest shelter.
facilities.routeProximity: About 6.89 km from Salka and about 10 m from OSM route.

facilities.name: Kuoperjakka / Kebnekatan Raststuga
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node corroborated by Naturkartan/Lansstyrelsen rest-shelter record
facilities.description: Rest shelter for temporary breaks, with room for about 10 people, stove, wood and dry toilet. Overnight and firewood use are for emergencies only; no waste handling.
facilities.routeProximity: About 6.86 km from Salka and about 2 m from OSM route.

facilities.name: Salkastugorna shop
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM shop node; STF route/shop pages confirm Salka mountain shop
facilities.description: Mountain shop/resupply service in the Salka hut area, described by STF as a large assortment shop.
facilities.routeProximity: About 8 m from OSM route near section start.

facilities.name: Singi junction
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM guidepost node; STF/Naturkartan route descriptions
facilities.description: Major trail junction where official Kungsleden continues south toward Kaitumjaure and the popular Kebnekaise/Nikkaluokta access corridor branches east. Westward Nordkalottleden/Hukejaure context is also present.

facilities.name: STF Salka Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Remote STF mountain cabin at the section start and shared endpoint with section 4. Services include self-catering kitchen, shop, sauna, safety/help-phone context and no mobile coverage.
facilities.routeProximity: Stage start; about 20-21 m from OSM/Waymarked route start.

facilities.name: STF Singi Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Remote STF mountain cabin at the section end and major junction. Services include self-catering kitchen, limited pet-room context, safety/help-phone context and no mobile coverage. No shop is listed.
facilities.routeProximity: Stage end; about 1-28 m from OSM/Naturkartan route evidence depending on coordinate source.
